parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name matching 'adenosine A2a receptor' and target_dictionary.organism matching 'Homo sapiens'. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL identifier ascending.
